tree.devNote: bulletinUrl is the Questrom undergrad overview (https://www.bu.edu/academics/questrom/programs/undergrad/) because that is the url in src/data/bu-programs.js and what saved plans store as majorBulletinUrl; the official-bulletin link therefore lands on the overview, not the BSBA page (https://www.bu.edu/academics/questrom/programs/undergrad/bsba/). Switching needs a bu-programs.js change plus a majorBulletinUrl migration. Sources: Track A = the BSBA bulletin page (132 units); Track B = the Questrom UDC 'Fall 2019 – Spring 2025' requirements page (133 units). Counts are courses, not units: 1-unit XP 301, 2-unit SM 132 and the ES career courses each count as one course. minGrade is null because the grade rules differ by course group (see the Grades cards).

Economics: The bulletin's macro line reads 'QST BE 102 or CAS EC 101'; that's a typo for EC 102. The unused alternate of each pair is excluded from the elective pools below so it can't count twice. View node: re-reads courses counted by the elective cards listed in viewOf (never the core cards), adds nothing to the program total and doesn't hold the track back. Picker choice is browser-only (useRequirementPicks). Rename pairs: both keys in B-lists, OR_EQUIVALENT in A/required slots. Catalog-missing keys dropped except QSTLA325. 12 B units = 3 courses (8 = 2); SHA HF 314 + 315 is one bundled slot that the outside-Questrom cap does NOT cover (engine caps are per list).
